instruction: Pull over near the motorbike ahead.
paraphrases: Stop close to the motorbike in front.|Park near the motorbike ahead.

instruction: Stop behind the bus in the distance ahead.
paraphrases: Pull up behind the distant bus.|Stop at the bus farther ahead.

instruction: Park beside the large white car closest to us on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearest large white car on the left.|Pull over by the prominent white car on the left.

instruction: Pass the white car on the left, then stop near the car ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the left white car and stop by the car ahead on the right.|After the white car on the left, pull over near the right car ahead.

instruction: Pass the partially visible car on the far left, then stop near the white sedan ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the cut-off car on the left and stop by the white sedan.|After the partly visible left car, pull over near the sedan ahead.

instruction: Stop behind the pickup on the left—correction, behind the white sedan in the middle.
paraphrases: Take the pickup on the left—rather, the central white sedan.|Stop behind the middle white sedan, not the left pickup.

instruction: Which car is on the right?
paraphrases: What car is on the right-hand side?|Identify the right-hand car.

instruction: Pass the white car on the left, then stop near the car ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the left white car and stop by the car in front.|After the left car, pull over near the car ahead.

instruction: Pull over beside the bus on the right.
paraphrases: Stop next to the bus on the right-hand side.|Park by the right-hand bus.

instruction: Stop near the parked car on the far left, not the cars driving ahead.
paraphrases: Take the parked car on the left edge, not the moving cars ahead.|Pull over by the far-left parked car rather than the traffic ahead.
